digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and epic infrastructure
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation time and trend-queryable via metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must enforce: no raw git writes bypassing store, no unread config schema fields, upper-bound wall-clock asserts in tests, complete AC checkboxes at close, code comments citing actual tickets not dead SHAs, and oversized bug-fix diffs require plan-review attestation.
Reconciler transport must be end-to-end typed with declared field asymmetries pinned by property tests and pagination deduplicated into shared iterators.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy.

Skill discipline (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, test-design standard) must encode approved upgrades including ticket writebacks, invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, and gate-finding oracle upgrades.

Epic completion attestation was missing due to stale-material reads after checkbox normalization; remediation required grandfathering pre-330c attestations via legacy hash byte-exact matching to restore certifiability and signing.
